svg.title: An unconstrained residual map can produce unbounded gain; a doubly stochastic one keeps the mean and bounds gain at one.
svg.desc: Comparing an unconstrained residual mixing matrix, whose arbitrary positive and negative entries can cancel or compound without limit, against the mHC target: a doubly stochastic matrix whose non-negative entries make each row and column sum to one, which preserves the cross-stream mean and bounds gain at one.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Constraining the residual map changes what it can do
